cards.headline:
Two witnesses signed.
The divorce was registered.

labels.kicker: Taiwan trial court · divorce by agreement

foot: But the husband said he didn't even know who they were.

cards.speaker: Wife → a friend
cards.headline: Can you sign as a witness here?
foot: It was just the wife and the friend. The husband wasn't there.

cards.headline:
I don't have
her husband's number.

facts: Never met the husband before or after signing
Never asked him if he wanted a divorce

foot: The court didn't count the friend as a witness.

cards.headline:
A witness must see or hear
that both spouses want out.
foot:
Hearing it secondhand doesn't count,
even from one of the spouses.

cards.headline:
Only two witnesses signed,
and the friend didn't count.

labels.result:
The other witness wasn't ruled on;
fewer than two → void.

foot:
Following case law, the judge asked whether each witness
saw or heard that both spouses wanted out.
